name: tr_quickley
caption:
IF QUICKLEY WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

😴 Snorlax, the sleeper: the 25th pick
⚡ Jolteon, the spark plug: 2nd in Sixth Man of the Year voting
🗡️ Bisharp, the dagger: buzzer-beating three, 97-96 over Charlotte
🎯 Alakazam, the sharpshooter: 40 points on 11-of-13, the most efficient 40 ever
🐧 Empoleon, the playmaker: 5.8 assists a night through 8 games
🥷 Greninja, the ace: quick by name, 17.4 points a night through 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Quickley was drafted with the 25th overall pick (#25) in 2020; finished second (2nd) in the voting for the Sixth Man of the Year Award (6MOY) in 2023; January 7, 2026: buzzer-beating three-point shot for a 97-96 victory over the Charlotte Hornets; January 20, 2026: 40 points on 11-of-13 shooting in a 145-127 win over Golden State, described as the most efficient 40-point game in league history
